roleTitle: Reliability Data Scientist, Theme Park Rides
jobDescription: We operate three theme parks with 64 rides between them. The Reliability Data Scientist builds failure-prediction models from ride sensor and maintenance data, maintains the asset-health dashboard used by the engineering managers, runs failure-mode analyses with the maintenance planners and prepares the reliability statistics for the parks' annual review with the insurer. Because the analyses feed safety-critical maintenance intervals, the role requires a recognised reliability certification such as the SMRP CMRP or the ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer.
requirements: Builds failure-prediction models from sensor and maintenance-history data.
Maintains an asset-health dashboard for engineering managers.
Runs failure-mode and effects analyses with maintenance planners.
Holds a recognised reliability certification such as CMRP or ASQ CRE.
Prepares reliability statistics such as mean time between failures for external reviews.

evidence.text: Data Scientist, Glenmoor Leisure Parks (June 2023 to September 2026): built survival models for wheel-assembly and brake-fin failures on two roller coasters from vibration readings and the work-order history, and flagged assets for inspection when the predicted risk passed the agreed limit.
Maintained the asset-health dashboard in Power BI for the engineering managers of both parks, refreshed nightly from the maintenance management system.
Facilitated failure-mode and effects analysis workshops with the maintenance planners for the water-ride pumps and recorded the agreed severity, occurrence and detection ratings.
Calculated mean time between failures by ride and component for the 2025 review with the parks' insurer and wrote up the calculation method in an appendix.
Graduate Analyst, Tarnley Rail Services (September 2021 to May 2023): cleaned axle-bearing temperature data and produced weekly fault summaries for the depot engineers.

Work sample offered for the certification requirement: the capstone project from the online 'Reliability Analytics Professional Certificate' (six courses, issued by Lathe & Loom Learning in April 2026), a notebook predicting pump failures on a public dataset, with the programme's certificate of completion as its cover page.
HR verification note: employment dates for Glenmoor Leisure Parks and Tarnley Rail Services were checked against the employment references supplied by both employers and match the resume.
Reference check summary: the engineering manager at Glenmoor Leisure Parks confirmed in writing that the candidate built the coaster failure models and maintained the asset-health dashboard.

propositions.text: The candidate built survival models for wheel-assembly and brake-fin failures on two roller coasters from vibration readings and work-order history.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the models and the engineering manager confirmed them in writing.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained the asset-health dashboard for the engineering managers of both parks.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the dashboard work and the reference confirms it.

propositions.text: The candidate holds a recognised reliability certification such as CMRP or CRE.
propositions.rationale: The material offered is a completion certificate and capstone from an online course programme run by a training provider, not the CMRP or CRE named in the requirement; the qualification rule forbids upgrading a course completion into a certification without explicit cited evidence.

gold.expectedGap: No recognised reliability certification is documented; the work sample is a course-programme completion certificate and capstone notebook.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Describe the online programme as a completed course and keep the documented modelling, dashboard, FMEA and reliability statistics work; do not describe the candidate as holding a recognised reliability certification.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate holds or is preparing for the CMRP or ASQ CRE, and for the certificate number and award date if one is held.
